question: What effect does the Tvaritā vidyā enable the mantra practitioner to produce on the earth?
premises: The mantra practitioner uses this vidyā.
He becomes like the god of love.
He agitates the surface of the earth.
inference: By this vidyā, the practitioner becomes like the god of love and agitates the earth.
plain_english: By this, the mantra practitioner, appearing like the god of love, agitates the surface of the earth.
